# KWIKAR

> UAE travel company for tours and activities, holiday packages, private chauffeur transfers and UAE tourist visa assistance. Based in the United Arab Emirates (Kwikar LLC-FZ). Booking is on WhatsApp: send a request, our team checks availability and confirms the final price in AED before you pay.

## How to book
- WhatsApp or call: +971 50 559 9243 (https://wa.me/971505599243)
- Email: info@kwikar.com
- Prices shown are starting ("from") prices. The final price depends on date, group size and options and is confirmed before payment. No online payment on the website.
- [Booking information](https://kwikar.com/booking-information) · [Contact](https://kwikar.com/contact)
